examples.text: Los Estados Unidos sí intervienen. Lo han hecho históricamente en América.
examples.translation: It is the United States that intervenes. It has done so historically in Latin America.

examples.english: Kilmar Ábrego García, 29-year-old father of three children with disabilities, is a Salvadoran citizen who entered the United States illegally around 2011, when he was an teenager, fleeing from gang violence, as his family maintains.

examples.text: Kilmar Ábrego García, de 29 años, padre de tres hijos con discapacidades, es un ciudadano salvadoreño que entró a Estados Unidos de forma irregular alrededor de 2011, cuando era adolescente, huyendo de la violencia de las pandillas, según asegura su familia.
examples.translation: Kilmar Ábrego García, 29-year-old father of three children with disabilities, is a Salvadoran citizen who entered the United States illegally around 2011, when he was an teenager, fleeing from gang violence, as his family maintains.
